pets.name: Divine Wolf
pets.source: Seis capturas adjuntas por el usuario en la conversacion del 2026-10-04; transcripcion visual. Imagenes sin ruta local disponible.

skills.name: Basic Attack
skills.desc: Pet's basic attack. Drain 1% HP from target and recover to master.
skills.notes: No especifica si el drenaje usa HP actual o maximo.

skills.name: Shadow Strike
skills.desc: Use shadow to create blade and strike enemy from below. Disables target's weapon attack for 4 turns.

skills.name: Shadow Strangle
skills.desc: Use shadow to create multiple hand and prevent enemy from move, stun enemy target for 3 turns.

skills.name: Sacred Wolf Blessing
skills.desc: Focus inner mind to help master target enemy. Increase master accuracy by 100%. (4 turns).
skills.notes: La ficha no especifica formula, acumulacion ni limites de precision; no garantiza acierto absoluto.

skills.name: Secret: Divine Wolf Barrage
skills.desc: Make the world engulf in darkness and secretly attack all enemies. Reduce all targets max HP by 10%.

skills.name: Secret: Onmyouji Divination
skills.desc: Use onmyouji power to help master. Heals 450 of master's HP and remove all negative status effect.

pets.name: Kyubi
pets.source: Capturas de habilidades proporcionadas por el usuario. Las seis habilidades de Kyubi estan documentadas; los valores no visibles permanecen sin dato.

skills.name: Basic Attack
skills.desc: Pet's Basic Attack. Applies 10% Bleeding onto the enemy for 1 turn

skills.name: Light Fire Ball
skills.desc: Blow out a small fire ball from pet's mouth which causes 5% Burn. (3 turns).

skills.name: Gedo Cannon
skills.desc: Shoot out a Chakra beam, target will not allow to use any jutsu (3 turns).

skills.name: Gedo Armor
skills.desc: Increase pet's attack damage by 100% and critical chance by 25% (Side effect: take extra damage by 20%) (4 turns).

skills.name: Secret: Fire Bullet Combo
skills.desc: Throw a giant fire ball out, and split into many small fire balls. All targets HP will be reduced by 10% (2 turns)

skills.name: Secret: Broken Gedo World
skills.desc: Shoot out a Chakra beam to a whole area, targets will have their agility reduced by 30% for 3 turns. This attack is highly accurate.

pets.notes: No se confirma si los porcentajes no especificados usan HP actual o maximo. No se conoce el orden de eleccion de habilidades.

pets.name: Easter Gobi
pets.source: Capturas de habilidades proporcionadas por el usuario el 2026-10-05. Los valores no visibles permanecen sin dato.

skills.name: Wind Tag: Hot Wind
skills.desc: Hot wind attack. Reduce 10% target's dodge rate (1 turn)

skills.name: Lightning Tag: Red Thunder
skills.desc: Red Lightning which make enemy unable to move. Stun target for 2 turns

skills.name: Fire Tag: Explosive Flame
skills.desc: Burn to reduce enemy's 5% HP. (2 turns)

skills.name: Earth Tag: Red Earth
skills.desc: Protect master from all attacks. (2 turns)

skills.name: Water Tag: Aqua Regia
skills.desc: Corrode enemy with aqua regia. Poison to enemy, target reduce 2%HP each turn. (2 turns)

skills.name: Secret: Five Tag Infinity
skills.desc: Attack all enemies with different elements. Reduce all target's HP & CP by 10%

pets.notes: No se confirma si los porcentajes no especificados usan HP actual o maximo. No se conoce el orden de eleccion de habilidades.
